description: This file defines the 'MedicalAgent' class, which implements a medical recommendation system using a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach over a mock vector store of medical guidelines. It provides methods for suggesting medicines based on user queries, retrieving relevant guideline snippets, and including necessary disclaimers.

classes.name: MedicalAgent
classes.description: A class that provides medical recommendations and guideline retrieval based on user queries, with safety disclaimers and heuristic medicine suggestions.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MedicalAgent instance by loading the vector store used for guideline retrieval.

methods.name: List[str] _medicine_suggestions(self, user_query: str)
methods.description: Generates heuristic medicine suggestions based on common keywords found in the user query, with safety caveats.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from a list while maintaining the original order.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves relevant guideline snippets, adds medicine suggestions if allowed, deduplicates results, appends a disclaimer, and returns the list of recommendations.

ctags.name: recommend
ctags.pattern: /^    def recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True) -> List[str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
